map.由横基尺长度与夹角求距离 使用指南: Distance from Base Length and Angle User Guide
map.输入横基尺长度 c 与经纬仪所对夹角 θ（度），按 D=c/tan(θ) 计算待: Enter the base length c and the angle θ (degrees) subtended by the theodolite and compute the distance to the target as D = c/tan(θ) — an indirect distance method using a base and angles when you have no rangefinder.
map.输入横基尺长度 c 与所对夹角 θ（度），求距离。: Enter the base length c and the subtended angle θ (degrees) to find the distance.
map.由定长横尺张角算距离 D=cot(θ/2)·b。: Compute the distance from a fixed base and its subtended angle as D = cot(θ/2)·b.
map.无测距仪时测距。: Distance measurement when you have no rangefinder.
map.：横尺长 b=2m、张角 θ=2° → D=cot(1°)×2=57.29×2≈: : with base b = 2 m and subtended angle θ = 2° → D = cot(1°)×2 = 57.29×2 ≈ 114.6 m.
map.：θ 小则 D 对 θ 极敏感，需精测角；θ 大（近距）更准，远距换视距/EDM: : for a small θ, D is highly sensitive to θ so the angle must be measured precisely; a larger θ (short distance) is more accurate, while for long distances switch to stadia or EDM.
map.由半径与转角求切线长: Tangent Length from Radius and Deflection Angle
map.D=b/2 / tan(θ/2)=b·cot(θ/2)，b 为已知横尺长、θ 为: D = b/2 / tan(θ/2) = b·cot(θ/2), where b is the known base length and θ is the subtended angle.
map.EDM 普及后用得少，教学与无电场景仍用，原理清晰。: Rarely used since EDM became common, but still applied in teaching and in situations without electricity, and its principle is clear.
